title: A family member needs your reset link
scenario: Your partner says they are locked out of a shared household account and asks you to forward the password-reset email so they can finish the reset on their phone.

answers.A: Use the service’s family/delegated access if available instead of sharing reset tokens.
answers.B: Forward the reset link because you trust your partner and the account is shared anyway.
answers.C: Do not forward the reset link; initiate the reset together and update the password through the official account settings.

explanation: Reset links are temporary master keys and can be abused if the partner’s device or message account is compromised.
proTip: Trust the person; still protect the credential.
